mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral (> -0.5%) in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past two months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or neutral (< 1%) in > 50% of instances following the demand signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or neutral (> -0.2%) in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or neutral (> -0.5%) in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply-side signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or neutral (> -0.5%) in > 60% of triggered instances despite the combined monetary signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in the past month, coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals a strong labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE drops > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or neutral (> -0.2%) in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or neutral (< 1%) in > 50% of instances following the housing demand signal.

mechanism_narrative: When Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% over the past two months, the combined signal indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or neutral (> -0.5%) in > 60% of triggered instances despite the combined economic weakness signal.
